display.purpose: Page titles only — repository names, view heads, the login gate. One grotesque carries display and body alike.

headline.purpose: Modal titles, empty-state titles, settings section leads.

title.purpose: Sidebar wordmark and strong card headers.

body.purpose: Rows, descriptions, badges' neighbors. Secondary copy at 13px.

label.purpose: Action-bar labels and quiet section labels.

mono.purpose: Measured things only: paths, short SHAs, signed counters (↑n ↓n), join codes, proof reports — always with tabular numerals.

shadows.name: plaque-rest
shadows.purpose: Cards, active nav, active tabs, status chips — plaques resting on porcelain.

shadows.name: kiln-float
shadows.purpose: Modals and the SSH directory browser — the deepest layer in the app.

shadows.name: button-rest
shadows.purpose: Cobalt primary plaques at rest — glaze top-light plus a soft cobalt drop.

shadows.name: button-hover
shadows.purpose: Cobalt primary plaques on hover — the drop deepens, the plaque darkens.

shadows.name: button-press
shadows.purpose: Pressed state — the glaze sinks; the button drops 0.5px.

shadows.name: cta-float
shadows.purpose: The cobalt CTA plaque — the app's one saturated block.

shadows.name: glaze-light
shadows.purpose: Top light falling on glaze — cobalt primary buttons and the CTA plaque.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: Modal entry (180ms rise + scale) and toast entry (240ms blur-to-sharp).

motion.name: sheen-busy
motion.purpose: The fired-glaze sheen sweeping primary buttons while busy — the one authored motion moment.

motion.name: state-fade
motion.purpose: All hover/active/route-state transitions; never bouncy, never staggered.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The cobalt plaque — the app's primary action. Busy state sweeps the fired-glaze sheen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: var(--color-primary, #2c4b8f); color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 24px; height: 40px; font-family: inherit; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; box-shadow: var(--shadow-btn); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover, #24407a); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--color-primary-deep, #1c3260); transform: translateY(0.5px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #2c4b8f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: var(--color-clay-strong, #e1dccb); color: var(--color-ink-faint, #8f8a7d); box-shadow: none; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The white plaque — secondary and cancel actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--color-ink, #25272c); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong, #d2cbb9); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 20px; height: 40px; font-family: inherit; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.85); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-surface-2, #faf9f5); border-color: var(--color-border-hover); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #2c4b8f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Input
components.description: The engraved slot — white plaque, hairline, cobalt focus ring, cobalt caret.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--color-ink, #25272c); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong, #d2cbb9); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 16px; height: 40px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 16px; caret-color: var(--color-primary, #2c4b8f); transition: border-color 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-muted, #6c6a63); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary, #2c4b8f); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(44,75,143,0.14); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The glazed plaque — every surface container rests on the porcelain body with a hairline and soft light.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline, #e6e1d4); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(37,39,44,0.04), 0 3px 10px rgba(37,39,44,0.05); font-family: inherit; color: var(--color-ink, #25272c); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Clay-field nav; active becomes a white plaque with a carved 3px cobalt tick.
components.css: .ds-nav { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-ink, #25272c); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); } .ds-nav-active { background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-hairline, #e6e1d4), 0 1px 2px rgba(37,39,44,0.04), 0 3px 10px rgba(37,39,44,0.05); } .ds-nav-active::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -8px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 3px; height: 15px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-primary, #2c4b8f); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small glazed chip; the danger variant rides the cross-hatch mark so conflict never lives in color alone.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 22px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-clay, #ece8dd); color: var(--color-ink-muted, #6c6a63); font-family: inherit; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-badge-danger { background-color: var(--tint-danger, #f9eeec); color: var(--color-danger, #ad392c); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(173,57,44,0.22) 0 2px, transparent 2px 5px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgba(173,57,44,0.22) 0 2px, transparent 2px 5px); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: The signed counter — mono, tabular, painted on a white plaque. Value and trend together.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline, #e6e1d4); background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); font-family: ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: var(--text-display-sm); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #6c6a63); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.85); }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Underglaze plates — a clay plate holding white active segments.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; background: var(--color-clay, #ece8dd); border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline, #e6e1d4); border-radius: var(--radius-plate); padding: 3px; } .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 30px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-tab); background: transparent; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #6c6a63); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--color-ink, #25272c); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); } .ds-tab-active { background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--color-ink, #25272c); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-hairline, #e6e1d4), 0 1px 2px rgba(37,39,44,0.04), 0 3px 10px rgba(37,39,44,0.05); }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Fired dark porcelain: enters with a blur-to-sharp settle; a tinted icon tile carries the kind.
components.html: 커밋 완료
components.css: .ds-toast { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-plate); background: var(--color-toast); color: var(--color-canvas); font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(37,39,44,0.05), 0 10px 28px rgba(37,39,44,0.12); animation: dsToastIn 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } @keyframes dsToastIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-10px); filter: blur(4px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; filter: blur(0); } } .ds-toast-ico { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: var(--radius-xs); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-success) 22%, transparent); color: var(--color-toast-celadon); }

narrative.overview: Git Companion is drawn as a precious record-keeping object rather than a gray SaaS dashboard: a moon-jar porcelain body with one cobalt underglaze accent, where the daily git loop — committing, pushing, merging, stashing — is the act of inscribing durable records on porcelain. Every surface is a ceramic material, never flat neutral: the workspace canvas is the warm-white porcelain body, cards are glazed plaques, the sidebar is unfired clay, and state is 'engraved' into the surface with 1px hairlines and hatch/cross-hatch marks so color is never the sole signal (a deliberate donation from instrument-world challengers at direction time: state must survive without color). The system is deliberately quiet: one saturated accent (cobalt), ceramic-status hues (celadon / iron / copper) held at legible-but-muted depth, warm-gray ink instead of pure black, and shadows soft enough to read as light falling on glaze. Density stays at developer-tool level — ledgers, tabular counters, mono hashes, tight rows — so the warmth never slides into decoration. The one authored motion moment is the fired-glaze sheen that sweeps a primary button while it is busy, and the toast that enters like a glaze setting (blur-to-sharp settle). The old pink-on-white travel-inventory look is the confirmed anti-reference.
keyCharacteristics: One saturated accent — cobalt underglaze — used structurally (primary plaques, active ticks), never as decal.
Materials over colors: porcelain canvas, glazed plaques, clay sidebar, engraved hairlines.
State reads by pattern as well as color: cross-hatch = conflict, hatch = staged/active marks, solid = clean.
Signed tabular counters (↑n ↓n) and mono measurement chips instead of decorative stats.
Soft porcelain light: every shadow carries offset + blur; no hard or colored shadows.
Korean-first type: Pretendard Variable, one grotesque for display and body, system mono for paths/hashes/counters.

rules.name: The One Cobalt Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is scarce: one saturated block per screen (the Home CTA is the only full-cobalt plaque in the app). Everything else earns cobalt only as a mark — a tick, a ring, a tile, an icon.

rules.name: The Pattern-Carry Rule
rules.body: No state lives in color alone: conflict badges and conflict file items double-encode with the cross-hatch mark, the active nav item carries a carved cobalt tick, and staged/busy marks use hatched engraving. A user who cannot see hue still reads every state.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Numbers that mean something are set in mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums — counters, SHAs, ports, latencies. Numerals in a ledger never jitter.

dos: Do keep cobalt scarce — one saturated block per screen; elsewhere it is mark-sized (tick, ring, tile, icon).
Do engrave state: pair every hue with a pattern or mark (cross-hatch conflict, cobalt tick active, hatch for staged).
Do set counters, SHAs, ports, and paths in mono with tabular numerals.
Do use porcelain-white plaques over the warm canvas, separated by 1px hairlines and soft offset+blur shadows.
Do let glaze read as light: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.14–.16) top highlights on cobalt and plaque buttons.
donts: Don't use pure black ink, pure white flat canvases, or the old pink accent (#ff385c family) anywhere.
Don't put a colored edge thicker than 1px on cards, banners, or list rows.
Don't use gradient text, hard zero-blur offset shadows, or glow/halo effects.
Don't let a status exist in color alone — every state badge has its pattern or mark.
Don't use emoji or unicode glyphs where the icon system applies; icons are drawn Lucide strokes in one weight (2px, round caps).
Don't add kickers/eyebrows above headings, section numbers, or hero-metric stat cards — the world's information is ledger-dense, not poster-dense.
